title: Grateful Dead Live at Market Square Arena on 1976-10-01
source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC & SHN > AIFF > Final Cut > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging) March 17, 2025

ai_review.summary: A stellar matrix capture with thundering Phil bass and an overall fantastic Dead show.
ai_review.review: All three reviewers rave about the Hunter Seamon matrix, calling it a gold‑standard production with fuller sound and crystal‑clear balance. The performance itself is described as “fantastic,” highlighted by a powerful low‑end from Phil Lesh’s bass. No specific song grievances are noted, making this both a great listening experience and an exemplary example of Dead matrix recordings.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the musical performance and the matrix recording quality across three reviews, though the small sample size limits certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fuller sound with balanced mix; Phil's bass thunders, production praised as a personal gold standard for matrix recordings.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall show described as fantastic and energetic, with no specific criticisms of pacing or song selection.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass work thunders along with just the right amount of thump.
